[Council File 25-1083-S1]
Motion (Blumenfield – Yaroslavsky, Harris–Dawson) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning, concurrently with the implementation of Option C1, to report with recommendations for a subsequent ordinance to establish an Accelerated Implementation Framework, applicable to higher and moderate opportunity sites within Transit Oriented Development zones.

Yes

Westside Neighborhood Council
Palms Neighborhood Council
For:
